RYMseek Settings

RateYourMusic direct downloader to slskd & Navidrome
Open Navidrome ↗ Open slskd ↗
slskd Server & Authentication
The web address of your slskd instance.
Authentication (Choose either Username/Password or API Key)
The username you use to log into the slskd Web UI.
The password you use to log into the slskd Web UI.
OR
If configured under web.authentication.api_keys in slskd.yml.
URL of your Navidrome music streaming web app.
Search & Heuristic Selection Filters
Prioritizes folders matching this audio quality.
Skip peers with upload speeds below this (0 = disabled).
Skip peers with download queues exceeding this count.
How long to wait for slskd search responses.
Download Monitoring & Auto-Fallback
Monitors transfer progress in slskd. If the peer goes offline or files fail, RYMseek cancels stalled transfers and automatically tries the next best source.
Maximum alternative peer directories to try before giving up.
Percentage of failed tracks that triggers an automatic switch to the next source.
Post-Download Automation Webhook
Optional HTTP/HTTPS endpoint to trigger once an entire album finishes downloading. Use this to automatically execute your Windows .bat script (running beets and triggering a Navidrome scan) on your remote server.
